9.2 Palette CSS variables (aligned with header-footer HTML)
All yellow text on white backgrounds must use --gold-strong (#c99327), not --gold (#f9b933). This applies to nav link hover, mega-menu column headings, and mega-list link hover.
role="menubar" on primary nav, aria-haspopup on dropdown triggers, aria-expanded state
Keyboard navigation: Tab through primary items, Arrow keys within mega-menu, ESC to close
prefers-reduced-motion respected — disable transitions if set
Breadcrumb component on every non-home page with JSON-LD BreadcrumbList schema
The Certification featured tile is designed for quarterly rotation. Update the config file (not component code) as campaigns change:
